sources.fact: Spotlight Lymphoma processes scanned H&E-stained lymph node biopsies. Spotlight Trephine is listed as coming soon.
Samantha Perona (Westgate), CEO of Spotlight Pathology.
NHS England advertises an interactive cancer waiting-times dashboard from April 2026 covering the latest 12 months, alongside provider-level data extracts.

Fujifilm identifies UHDB cellular pathologist Nirav Gandhi as a customer in its SYNAPSE Pathology and Ibex partnership announcement. This does not establish complete digitisation or lymphoma compatibility.
Queen Victoria Hospital board papers describe site-specific digital histopathology integration and go-live delays. Network-level digital activity does not establish every member site's readiness.
East Sussex Healthcare reports introducing digital slide scanners and Sectra PACS, as the first laboratory in the Sussex Pathology Network to do so.
UHSussex's annual review publishes uhsussex.ridirectors@nhs.net as the shared contact for its research and innovation directors.

Company product page quotes Cheshire and Merseyside HODS clinical director Geetha Menon describing work with Spotlight. The testimonial does not establish a purchase or identify a contracting trust ODS code.

RAJ.name: Mid and South Essex NHS Foundation Trust

readiness.text: A Southend employer advert closing 22 November 2026 says a digital infrastructure upgrade will enable digital pathology access in the coming months. Trust-wide operational coverage has not been verified.

network.name: Mid and South Essex laboratory service / SYNLAB Essex
network.text: Trust page updated 13 November 2026 says laboratory services are provided by SYNLAB Essex from 1 October 2026, with a phased transition joining Basildon, Broomfield and Southend services.

RAJ.nextQuestion: Suggested: Which SYNLAB Essex laboratory reads the trust's lymphoma biopsies, and when will its slide scanning and digital reporting workflow be available for evaluation?

RAL.name: Royal Free London NHS Foundation Trust

readiness.text: NPIC announced Royal Free, UCLH and Whittington had gone live on its digital pathology network in August 2025. The announcement names Sectra, Exponential-e and Health Services Laboratories. Lymphoma-specific coverage and Spotlight compatibility are not established.

network.name: North Central London / Health Services Laboratories / NPIC

RAL.nextQuestion: Suggested: Can HSL's digital pathology team confirm local lymph-node scanning coverage and the evaluation route for an additional lymphoma triage tool?

RTG.name: University Hospitals of Derby and Burton NHS Foundation Trust

readiness.text: An employer advert closing 8 October 2026 describes implementation of full histopathology digitisation at Royal Derby. Fujifilm separately identifies a UHDB cellular pathologist as a customer; full service coverage has not been verified.
readiness.platform: Fujifilm SYNAPSE Pathology; full coverage unverified

network.name: Derbyshire Pathology
network.text: Employer identifies laboratories at Chesterfield Royal, Royal Derby and Queen's Hospital Burton as Derbyshire Pathology; histopathology is based at Royal Derby.

RTG.nextQuestion: Suggested: Are lymphoma biopsies included in the current digital reporting scope, and who owns evaluation and integration of additional tools in the Fujifilm workflow?

RYR.name: University Hospitals Sussex NHS Foundation Trust

readiness.text: A July 2026 NHS announcement reports an established shared digital histopathology service across the Sussex Pathology Network. This is network-level evidence; UHSussex site and lymphoma coverage need confirmation.
readiness.platform: Sectra evidenced at network member East Sussex Healthcare; UHSussex coverage unverified

network.name: Sussex Pathology Network
network.text: Network partners are East Sussex Healthcare, University Hospitals Sussex and Queen Victoria Hospital.

RYR.nextQuestion: Suggested: Which UHSussex sites currently scan and report lymph-node biopsies digitally, and would an evaluation be approved locally or through the Sussex Pathology Network?

RHM.name: University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust

readiness.text: The March 2026 Spotlight procurement describes integration and validation within UHS digital pathology, followed by intended routine workflow use. An operational go-live has not been independently verified.

relationship.text: Published Spotlight Lymphoma Diagnostic Triage contract award, reference WPL06379, 6 March 2026, estimated 23 March 2026 to 22 March 2030. Existing procurement relationship; clinical go-live is unverified.

RHM.nextQuestion: Suggested: What is the current validation and deployment stage under the existing award, and which rollout lessons can inform other sites?

RTD.name: The Newcastle upon Tyne Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust

readiness.text: Research collaboration is documented. The current clinical digital pathology deployment scope was not verified in this review.

relationship.text: The primary study Lymphoma triage from H&E using AI for improved clinical management includes Spotlight, Newcastle University and Newcastle Hospitals authors and Newcastle data. This establishes research collaboration, not a paying customer or clinical deployment.

RTD.nextQuestion: Suggested: Is the existing Spotlight research collaboration moving into clinical validation or deployment, and what is its current scope?

RR8.name: Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust

readiness.text: NPIC is based at Leeds Teaching Hospitals and operates a digital pathology programme. Local clinical lymphoma workflow coverage was not separately verified in this review.

relationship.text: NPIC's October 2024 announcement names a funded Spotlight HMDS project with Spotlight Pathology. Research collaboration; this does not make all NPIC member trusts Spotlight customers.

RR8.nextQuestion: Suggested: Which elements of the existing NPIC/Spotlight project are validated for clinical use and transferable to other member trusts?

R0A.name: Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust

readiness.text: A founder-linked research relationship is documented. Current trust-wide digital histopathology deployment scope was not verified in this review.

route.label: MFT industry research and innovation enquiry form

relationship.text: Spotlight cofounder and chief medical officer Richard Byers is an MFT consultant haematopathologist. MFT also appears in the company's primary lymphoma triage research. Treat as an existing founder-linked research relationship, not a new prospect or proven commercial customer.

R0A.nextQuestion: Suggested: What unmet deployment needs remain within the existing MFT relationship, and which local results could support rollout elsewhere?
